name: Homel
pointBasis: UN WUP2025 population-weighted settlement locator; not a municipal boundary or parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The agency's official homepage and service pages identify the organization and state-registration/land-management functions. The official branch page says the Gomel Agency serves Gomel city except Novobelitsky District; the Gomel branch covers Gomel District and Novobelitsky District. Exact administrative sub-area placement of the WUP point was not independently overlaid.
technicalBlocker: One unmodified valid nearby public WFS parcel (object_id 6722720) was returned through the official viewer-compatible anonymous query. It does not contain the unchanged WUP locator; the exact point query returned zero features. Current generic WFS adapter rejects the published UUID-with-hyphens feature type and does not implement the observed WFS 1.0.0 route. Complete paging/count consistency, all-grid fresh identities, footprint lookup and source binding remain unqualified. This is verified public geometry nearby, with runtime held for an unqualified reader, not evidence of parcel absence.

queries.query: Гомель кадастровая карта земельные участки Национальное кадастровое агентство Беларусь
queries.scope: Identify official city-specific cadastral custody and safe anonymous parcel geometry.
queries.result: The official NCA viewer describes a public GIS for State Land Cadastre spatial data. Anonymous WFS GetCapabilities returned HTTP 200 and lists the `pcm:…` land-parcels layer; anonymous DescribeFeatureType returned HTTP 200 and confirms a full polygon geometry field. The schema also contains address and organization attributes, so the bounded WUP-point GetFeature request was restricted to `geom` only, but the server closed that request without a response. No owner/address fields or credential headers were requested or retained.
queries.executionMethod: Separate native/local-language web search and first-party source review.

requests.result: Anonymous public WFS capabilities listed 436 feature types, including the layer titled Земельные участки (land parcels). Only layer names/titles were retained.
Anonymous schema response confirms object_id and geom fields plus address/organization attributes; only schema and field names were inspected.
Bounded exact-WUP query requesting at most three full geometry-only features; remote server closed the connection without a response. No geometry or attributes returned.
